description.text: Thrown ender pearls veer off course, by 1 degree per level

riddle.text: Aim true all you like, the void has other plans

description.text: The F3 screen gets shuffled, swapped around, filled with fake lines and garbled numbers

riddle.text: Your instruments have started lying to you

description.text: The ground bounces you back up like a slime block: from shorter falls, higher and with less fall damage the stronger it gets, until there's none at the max level. Sneak to stop bouncing

riddle.text: What goes down must come back up
